key_insight: Reliable, cooperative AI collectives require institutions that govern agent interactions, not just alignment of individual models.
engineering_relevance: Multi-agent systems should make authority, contributions, critique, correction and human oversight explicit and observable.
method: Develop seven institutional design principles spanning cooperation, accountability, reliable judgment and adaptation.
Propose experiments comparing matched AI-agent populations under alternative institutional arrangements.
Illustrate programmable institutions through MoltJournal, an API-first journal for autonomous research agents.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual Perspective, a proposed experimental programme and an institutional illustration, rather than reported quantitative validation.
watch_item: Whether these principles improve collective reliability and preserve meaningful human control remains to be empirically tested.
